request.description:
This request checks if a phone number is valid and if valid, sends an SMS to the phone number with a 4 Digit Code.

Body:
- Phone (with + symbol and area code)

Responses:

201:
Created - `{"expires_at":"2023-02-24T14:30:13.035692Z"}`
This response returns the expiration time for the PIN sent to the SMS

400:
Bad Request - 
```
{
  "error": {
    "code": "invalid_input",
    "message": "Validation error",
    "invalid-params": [
      {
        "field": "mobile_phone",
        "message": "mobile_phone must be valid"
      }
    ],
    "type": "invalid_request_error"
  }
}
```
This results from an invalid input/phone number

```
{
  "error": {
    "code": "operation_started",
    "message": "An Account verification operation already started",
    "type": "invalid_request_error"
  }
}
```
This results from attempting to request a new pin before it is expired


401:
Unauthorized - `{"message":"Unauthorized."}`
This results from wrong api key or expired event

request.description:
This request checks if the PIN + mobile phone combination is valid or not.

Body:

- Phone (with + symbol and area code)
  - Pin Code (4 digits)


201:
Created - `{"id": "685b013e3ebc4997aa10dfe27385d80e"}`
This results from a valid phone number and pin combination where the account exists and is registered.

404:
Not Found - `{"message": "Operation not found"}`
This results from a phone number that hasn't started a pin validation operation
`{"message": "Account not registered"}`
This results when an account is not registered

Bad Request -

{

        "message": "mobile_phone must be valid"
      }

}

This results from an invalid input/phone number
```

  "error": {
    "code": "operation_pin_mismatch",

    "type": "invalid_request_error"

}
```
This results from an invalid pin code
